access.title: Sign in to continue
access.description: Sign in with your Cloud account to continue to your organizations and clusters.

auth.loginDescription: Use your email and password to access your organizations.
auth.registerDescription: Create an account to set up your first Cloud organization.
auth.oauthComingSoon: Google and GitHub sign-in are coming soon.
auth.securityNote: Your session is protected by a secure, HttpOnly cookie.

errors.generic: We could not complete that request. Check your details and try again.
errors.network: The Cloud service could not be reached. Try again shortly.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.emailExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.

onboarding.title: Create your Cloud cluster
onboarding.description: Choose an organization name and an open region. Your first cluster will begin provisioning after setup.
onboarding.existingOrganizationDescription: Choose a name and region for a new cluster in this organization.
onboarding.slugHint: Use English letters and numbers so we can create a unique organization address.
onboarding.clusterNameHint: Use English letters and numbers, separated by hyphens.
onboarding.regionError: Available regions could not be loaded.
onboarding.noRegions: There are no regions open for provisioning right now.
onboarding.regionReadonly: The region cannot be changed after cluster creation.
onboarding.clusterPreviewEmpty: Name it by entering an organization name
onboarding.clusterPendingNote: Provisioning starts after you create the cluster.
onboarding.resumeError: The previous cluster setup could not be restored. You can start another cluster here.
onboarding.createError: Cluster setup did not finish. Retry to resume using the same organization and cluster names.
onboarding.startingDetail: Sending the creation request to Cloud…
onboarding.stageAcceptedDetail: Cloud accepted the request. Waiting for cluster provisioning to begin…
onboarding.stageProvisioningDetail: Cloud reports that cluster resources are provisioning.
onboarding.stageClusterReadyDetail: The cluster is ready. Waiting for all subscription resources to be ready.
onboarding.stageResourcesReadyDetail: Cloud reports that all subscription resources are ready.
onboarding.nextUpdateDetail: This page checks Cloud for the next status update.
onboarding.pollError: The latest status could not be loaded. Cloud status checks will continue automatically.
onboarding.readyDescription: Organization {{organization}} and its cluster are ready.
onboarding.failedDescription: Cloud reported that cluster provisioning failed.
onboarding.cancelledDescription: This Cluster is no longer being provisioned. Review the setup to start again.
onboarding.cleanupPending: Subscription cancelled. Waiting for the previous Cluster to finish releasing its resources before you create another one.
onboarding.cleanupStatusError: Unable to check cleanup status. This page will keep trying.
onboarding.preservedSettings: Your organization name “{{organization}}” and selected region have been preserved. You can retry without entering your settings again.
onboarding.retryError: The retry request could not be completed. Try again.
onboarding.readyCancelWarning: Cancelling this subscription will terminate cluster {{cluster}} and remove its resources.
onboarding.cancelSubscriptionError: Cancellation could not be confirmed. Review the deployment status before changing settings.
onboarding.cancelStatusError: Could not refresh the current deployment status. The cancellation request was not sent; try again.
onboarding.footnote: Cluster provisioning runs in the background. The console will show the status returned by Cloud.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: A summary of your Cloud organization and managed clusters.

clusters.title: Clusters
clusters.description: Review cluster status and open an authorized Cluster Console.

billing.cancelWarning: This will cancel the subscription, terminate its cluster, and remove its resources. This cannot be undone.
billing.title: Usage & billing
billing.description: Review usage for the current organization.
